newsitem.title: GREECE: Vioter, Sanyo Hellas capital increases approved.
newsitem.headline: Vioter, Sanyo Hellas capital increases approved.

text.p: The Athens bourse authorities approved the share capital increases of construction firm Vioter and Sanyo Hellas, it said in a statement.

Vioter will issue 1,277,961 common registered shares at 500 drachmas each and raise 639 million drachmas to finance its investment real estate programme in the Attica region and its working capital needs, it said.
Old shareholders will be entitled to two new common shares for 10 existing ones in accord with the firm's general shareholders meeting.

The bourse authorities also approved the prospectus for the share capital increase of Sanyo Hellas. The firm is going to issue 54,400 new shares in order to complete the merger with its subsidiary Echoelectriki.
